correctness.rationale: For every finite version space the full binary-tree recursion follows by induction on its number of hypotheses. Cardinality pruning is a necessary condition and cannot discard an improving query. A distinct topological-sort generator matches all enumerated zigzag permutations for n=2,...,8. Exact ranks are 0,1,2,4,5,7,9. The independent can-depth recursion excludes depth 10 at n=8 (75,626 memoized state-depth pairs). The complete depth-nine tree has 511 internal nodes and 512 distinct leaf witnesses checked along complete response paths. The static upper argument excludes n-1 comparisons for every n, and two-parity spanning stars achieve n-2.

value.rationale: The fence is a canonical height-two poset with Euler-number-many linear extensions. The exact comparison ranks locate the first one-bit information-bound deficit at seven positions and the first gap of three over the known VC dimension at eight positions. These thresholds have a clear online-learning interpretation and are neither an arbitrary support restriction nor just a recomputation of Euler numbers; the result is explicitly a finite cutoff and has no claimed large-n formula.
